title: Add sentence-scramble prober and progressive quarantine gate
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Motivation: Some prompt-sets show brittle behaviour when sentence-level token order is slightly perturbed; existing prober hooks focus on token-level noise and paraphrase injection but can miss ordering-sensitive regressions. This PR introduces a lightweight sentence-level scramble prober plus a progressive quarantine gate that gradually decays confidence and isolates affected cohorts for targeted rollback or replay. The change set includes a scheduler for controlled scramble severity, a consensus scorer that blends model agreement and reference-stability heuristics, a quarantine policy engine that escalates from soft-warn to partial-mirror to full quarantined state, and CI-integrated checks that surface regressions without causing immediate hard fail on early-stage instability. Checklist: 1) implement scramble prober and scheduler, 2) add consensus scorer and severity buckets, 3) wire quarantine policy into CI hook, 4) add unit + integration tests and example config, 5) update docs and temporal test fixtures. How to evaluate locally: run tests with `pytest tests/eval_probers/test_scramble.py` and trigger the prober via the smoke harness: `scripts/run_probe --type scramble --seed 42 --severity 0.3`. Expected outcome: stable runs should see <1% delta on main cohorts at low severity; targeted cohorts display graded degradation that surfaces in the `quarantine` report. Related work: builds on prior adversarial prober infra but uses sentence-level permutation instead of token-level noise; complements the synthetic-paraphrase prober. Linear tickets: ENG-1951 (design), ENG-1987 (ci integration).
commits: 3 commits: 1) add sentence_scrambler, scheduler, and unit tests; 2) add consensus scorer and severity bucketing; 3) integrate quarantine policy into ci hook and example configs

ci_checks: unit-tests: pass, lint: pass, mypy: pass, integration-smoke: initial flake on e2e masking; rerun integration-smoke: pass, load-test: pass
release_notes: Add sentence-level scramble prober to detect ordering-sensitive prompt regressions and a configurable progressive quarantine gate to isolate impacted cohorts; configurable severity and escalation timings; opt-in in ci.rules via examples/scramble-config.yaml
notes_for_release: Feature off by default; enable by adding a rule in ci/configs/probe-rules.yaml. Recommended baseline: run with severity=0.2 for one week on shadow traffic before enabling soft-warn on CI
testing_summary: Added unit tests for scramble generator and consensus scorer, integration test exercising scheduler progression and quarantine transitions, fixtures for three example cohorts, and a smoke CI job that runs the probe with deterministic seed to avoid flakiness.
